properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Browser origins allowed to call this service, comma separated, for the test console (console/console.html). Empty means CORS is off. Never set this in production. Set with CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

properties.name: internal.key
properties.description: Shared secret that agent-service and companion-api send in the X-Internal-Key header. Required. Set with INTERNAL_KEY.

properties.name: mpesa.base-url
properties.description: Daraja address. Sandbox: https://sandbox.safaricom.co.ke, production: https://api.safaricom.co.ke. Set with MPESA_BASE_URL.

properties.name: mpesa.consumer-key
properties.description: Daraja app consumer key. Required. Set with MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY.

properties.name: mpesa.consumer-secret
properties.description: Daraja app consumer secret. Required. Set with MPESA_CONSUMER_SECRET.

properties.name: mpesa.shortcode
properties.description: Paybill or Till number that receives the money. Set with MPESA_SHORTCODE.

properties.name: mpesa.passkey
properties.description: Passkey for the shortcode, used to build the STK Push password. Required. Set with MPESA_PASSKEY.

properties.name: mpesa.transaction-type
properties.description: CustomerPayBillOnline for a Paybill, CustomerBuyGoodsOnline for a Till number. Set with MPESA_TRANSACTION_TYPE.

properties.name: mpesa.public-base-url
properties.description: Public HTTPS address Safaricom can reach for callbacks. Include any gateway path prefix. Required. Set with PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

properties.name: mpesa.callback-secret
properties.description: Random string added to the callback URL so only Safaricom, who knows the URL, can post to it. Required. Set with MPESA_CALLBACK_SECRET.

properties.name: mpesa.callback-allowed-ips
properties.description: Safaricom source IPs allowed to call the callbacks, comma separated. Empty means no IP check. Set with MPESA_CALLBACK_ALLOWED_IPS.

properties.name: mpesa.operations.initiator-name
properties.description: Daraja initiator name for B2C, balance, status and reversal. Leave blank for STK Push only. Set with MPESA_INITIATOR_NAME.

properties.name: mpesa.operations.initiator-password
properties.description: Daraja initiator password, encrypted with the certificate. Set with MPESA_INITIATOR_PASSWORD.

properties.name: mpesa.operations.certificate-path
properties.description: Path to the Safaricom public certificate (sandbox or production). Set with MPESA_CERTIFICATE_PATH.

properties.name: mpesa.operations.security-credential
properties.description: A ready made SecurityCredential, used instead of the initiator password and certificate. Set with MPESA_SECURITY_CREDENTIAL.

properties.name: mpesa.operations.b2c-path
properties.description: Daraja B2C path. Check the current version on the Daraja portal. Set with MPESA_B2C_PATH.

properties.name: mpesa.operations.c2b-register-path
properties.description: Daraja C2B register URL path. Set with MPESA_C2B_REGISTER_PATH.

properties.name: mpesa.operations.c2b-response-type
properties.description: Default answer for C2B validation, Completed or Cancelled. Set with MPESA_C2B_RESPONSE_TYPE.

properties.name: mpesa.operations.qr-merchant-name
properties.description: Merchant name shown on dynamic QR codes. Set with MPESA_QR_MERCHANT_NAME.

properties.name: mpesa.operations.qr-trx-code
properties.description: Transaction code for dynamic QR codes, for example PB for Paybill. Set with MPESA_QR_TRX_CODE.

properties.name: mpesa.operations.qr-cpi
properties.description: Credit party identifier for dynamic QR codes. Set with MPESA_QR_CPI.

properties.name: operations.max-payout
properties.description: Largest single payout, in KES. Money leaving the business account: refunds, withdrawals, disbursements. Set with OPERATIONS_MAX_PAYOUT.

properties.name: operations.daily-payout-limit
properties.description: Most that can be paid out in one day, in KES. Set with OPERATIONS_DAILY_PAYOUT_LIMIT.

properties.name: operations.allow-self-approval
properties.description: Let the person who asked for a payout approve it. Keep false in production, so a second person approves every payout. Set with OPERATIONS_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVAL.

properties.name: business.name
properties.description: Business name shown on receipts. Set with BUSINESS_NAME.

properties.name: business.support-phone
properties.description: Support number shown on receipts. Set with BUSINESS_SUPPORT_PHONE.

properties.name: payments.limits.per-transaction
properties.description: Largest single payment, in KES. Set with PAYMENT_LIMIT_PER_TX.

properties.name: payments.limits.per-day
properties.description: Most one phone can pay in a day, in KES. Set with PAYMENT_LIMIT_PER_DAY.

properties.name: payments.reconcile.enabled
properties.description: Turn on the job that asks Daraja about payments whose callback never arrived.

properties.name: payments.reconcile.interval
properties.description: How often the reconcile job runs.

properties.name: payments.reconcile.min-age
properties.description: How old a pushed payment must be before the job checks it.

properties.name: payments.reconcile.give-up-after
properties.description: How long the job keeps checking before it gives up on a payment.
